inlines.v: DISHONORABLE, adjective 1. Shameful; reproachful; base; vile; bringing shame on; staining the character, and lessening reputation. Every act of meanness, and every vice is dishonorable 2. Destitute of honor; as a dishonorable man. 3. In a state of neglect or disesteem. He that is dishonorable in riches, how much more in poverty?
